messages:
elena: Quick heads-up — planning to enable orbit-1.0 in the model catalog at 11:10PT. It's compatible overall but KV layout changed; need fallback ordering and pin plan. @jason @maya @liam
jason: 👍 what's the canary target? suggest start 1% for 30m then 5% for 1h
maya: prefer fallback order: quantized-orbit-0.9 -> orbit-0.9-peg -> model-generic-v2. Quantized first to save cost and preserve latency.
liam: +1 but we should pin orbit-0.9 for Dedicated customers for 24h to avoid surprise perf deltas for reserved pools
elena: rollout window 11:10-13:10PT. Rollback triggers: >1% error sustained for 5m OR latency p95 >2x baseline for 10m. Also healthcheck mismatch >0.5% for rerank tasks.
jason: can you put that into the catalog policy? example config: ```
fallback_order:
 - quantized-orbit-0.9
 - orbit-0.9-peg
 - model-generic-v2
canary: 1%
canary_duration: 30m
pin_dedicated: true
rollback_triggers:
  error_rate: 1%
  latency_multiplier: 2.0
```
maya: QA plan: run prompt-set A (regression suite) and perf-run at seq lengths [32,128,512]. I'll kick the eval at 11:05 and post results.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: catalog.enable_model orbit-1.0 -> TARGET: hosted,dedicated. ETA 11:10PT. Initiator: elena
liam: pls add region failover ordering EU->US if EU capacity low. Prefer fallback to local quantized variant before cross-region.
elena: updated — will attach per-region fallback matrix to the release note. @eng-oncall please monitor traces, error groups, and cost deltas.
eng-oncall: oncall acked. Will escalate on first rollback trigger and open a Sev if we cross thresholds.
jason: if canary looks good after 90m, plan to ramp to 20% then to 100% over 2h rolling windows.
maya: keeping watch for quality regressions; will post eval summary once tests finish.
deploy-bot: deploy started: catalog.enable_model orbit-1.0 canary=1%
elena: thanks — I'll be available during the window. Ping me immediately for anomalies :eyes:
maya: eval done — prompt-set A passed (no semantic regressions). Perf: p95 within ~1.1x baseline at seq=128. Artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/orbit-1.0/eval 
deploy-bot: canary stable at 1% after 30m. proceeding with automated ramp to 5%
jason: proceeding with 5% for 1h. If metrics stable, we follow the ramp plan.
deploy-bot: ramp complete -> 5% canary
elena: decision logged: per-region fallback matrix enabled, Dedicated pin for 24h, rollback triggers as listed. I'll add concise release-note blurb and notify customers. Thanks team. :tada:
